metadata.name: sqlclient
metadata.description: (db [, title]) - open a SQLite client WINDOW on db: a query editor, a tables sidebar, and the result rows below (rendered as a grid + materialized into real sqlres.* cels). e.g. =sqlclient("demo")

metadata.name: sqlclientui
metadata.description: (db, query, tablesData, results, error) - the client panel vnode: query textarea + Run, tables sidebar, results grid. Pure render; state lives in sqlc.<db>.* cels.

metadata.name: sqlc.run
metadata.description: Handler: run sqlc.<db>.query, store rows in sqlc.<db>.results, materialize them into sqlres.* cels, refresh the table list, surface errors.

metadata.name: sqlc.refresh
metadata.description: Handler: repopulate the sidebar's table list from the live schema (on window open or on demand).

metadata.name: sqlc.selectTable
metadata.description: Handler: a sidebar table click (payload "db::table") fills the editor with SELECT * FROM table LIMIT 100 and runs it.

metadata.name: sqlc.key
metadata.description: Handler: ⌘/Ctrl+Enter in the query editor runs the query.
